transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. I'll be working, and if a saw starts up, or... somebody just walks past, I get pulled right off whatever I'm doing. And then... the whole day just kind of gets away from me.
How long have you been experiencing this difficulty with your focus?

About a year and a month, I suppose. Um... I broke my wrist back then, so... they shifted me off the hands-on carpentry. Put me on shop paperwork and supervising instead. It's... been like this since then.
Did you have any difficulties with paying attention, organizing, or focusing when you were in school as a child?

I suppose... yeah. Even back in grade school, I guess... before I was 12. Teachers were always telling my mother I was... bright, but careless. Just... losing my homework. Forgetting instructions. I'd end up just... staring out the window instead of finishing my seatwork. So... yeah.
Aside from the trouble focusing, have you been experiencing feelings of sadness, low mood, or anxiety since your job changed?
No... not really. I mean, I'm not sad. Just... frustrated that I can't seem to get the paperwork done right. But no... nothing like that.
